## Auditable ballots
Account, comment link, timestamp, choice, proposal version, and disclosed interests for each counted ballot. Record superseded or excluded ballots and reasons separately. Record disputes; do not expose private data.

## Decision and reasoning
Accept, revise, defer, or reject. Identify the decision owner. Explain evidence, strongest dissent, unresolved risks, and any departure from the majority recommendation. Distinguish an owner decision from community support.
